what: Once, when the big heading comes into view — each word gets a rounded pill (a capsule grown by .3 of the word height left and right and .095 up and down), and a distance band merging all the pills fills up from deep inside the pills, becoming a solid pill mass in 1s expo.inOut, then thins to a 2px border in .5s expo.out. Where words touch, the border joins into one and a small triangle remains in the gap. The moment the fill ends, the words grow from .85 to 1 scale over .75s expo.out and appear

options.line: Final border thickness (px), default 2 — 4 for the large wordmark
options.grow · thin · pop: Fill-up · thinning · word grow durations (s), default 1 · .5 · .75
options.padx · pady: Margin around the word (ratio to word height), default .3 · .095
options.from: Depth where the band starts (ratio of title width, negative is inward), default -.75
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Word to wrap in the pill (child, required) — spaces are left as they are and only the word is wrapped
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Line group (child, if present) — if a line has q, p, g, j or y, its pill is nudged down slightly

note: The original draws with a full-screen WebGL plane using a shader with one capsule distance field per word and moves the plane position on every scroll. This part draws the same distance band inside the heading on a 2D canvas (sum of capsules grown to the outer end minus sum of capsules grown to the inner end), so no separate scroll syncing is needed. Color comes from the element’s color. The band overflows the heading box by half a word height, so leave margin around it.

from.where: All subpages’ .zk-title big title · first page wordmark (4px) — the original WebGL pill (distance −.75→−.25 1s expo.inOut, → 0 · 2px/width .5s expo.out, word .85→1 .75s expo.out).
